SELECT d.id, d.legacy_id, d.title, d.description, c0.slug, d.district, d.icon
FROM discovery.discovery_entries AS d
INNER JOIN catalog.cities AS c ON d.city_id = c.id
INNER JOIN catalog.categories AS c0 ON d.category_id = c0.id
WHERE c.slug = @filter_CitySlug AND c.is_active AND d.is_published AND c0.is_active AND d.title || ' ' || d.description || ' ' || d.district ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY d.legacy_id IS NULL, d.legacy_id, d.id
LIMIT @p

SELECT h.id, h.legacy_id, h.title, h.description, c0.slug, h.district, h.icon
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM discovery.discovery_entries WHERE ((legacy_id IS NULL), COALESCE(legacy_id,0), id) > (@p0, @p1, @p2)
) AS h
INNER JOIN catalog.cities AS c ON h.city_id = c.id
INNER JOIN catalog.categories AS c0 ON h.category_id = c0.id
WHERE c.slug = @filter_CitySlug AND c.is_active AND h.is_published AND c0.is_active AND h.title || ' ' || h.description || ' ' || h.district ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY h.legacy_id IS NULL, h.legacy_id, h.id
LIMIT @p4
